thesis: AZTA is a high-beta, crowded-short, post-gap name being bought into a 0.93-confidence risk-off tape with VIX at the 99.5th percentile and QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages. The stock has already run about 141% in 126 days and is 13.4% above SMA20, so the earnings beat is largely priced in at a forward P/E of 52.9 and with the mean analyst target only about 12% above the close. The 11/19 reversal from 49.64 to 47.09 on above-average volume looks like supply at the high, and the first resistance at 50.06 offers only about 1.3 R, so the 3.5 R headline depends on a breakout that the regime makes unlikely. In a liquidation, a beta-1.47 name with 21.7% short interest can gap through the 42.9 stop, and the post-gap lows and the unfilled earnings gap are the obvious magnets.
